mapper.sql: (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(R.ROLE_NM ORDER BY R.SORT_NO SEPARATOR ', ') FROM TB_EEP_USER_ROLE_R U JOIN TB_EEP_ROLE_M R ON R.ROLE_SQ = U.ROLE_SQ WHERE U.EMPLY_ID = E.EMPLY_ID) AS ROLE_NMS , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_USER_ROLE_R U JOIN TB_EEP_ROLE_M R ON R.ROLE_SQ = U.ROLE_SQ WHERE U.EMPLY_ID = E.EMPLY_ID AND R.ROLE_CD = 'SUPER') AS SUPER_CNT
mapper.select: SELECT E.EMPLY_SQ, E.EMPLY_ID, E.EMPLY_NM, E.EMPLY_EMAIL, E.EMPLY_PH_NUM, E.EMPLY_AUTH_TYP_CD , IFNULL(E.USE_YN, 'Y') AS USE_YN, IFNULL(E.DEL_YN, 'N') AS DEL_YN, E.PW_INIT_YN , DATE_FORMAT(E.LAST_LOGIN_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS LAST_LOGIN_DT, LEFT(E.EMPLY_REG_DT, 10) AS REG_DT , S.STAFF_SQ, S.STATUS_CD AS STAFF_STATUS, S.STAFF_NM , FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M E LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M S ON S.EMPLY_ID = E.EMPLY_ID ORDER BY E.EMPLY_NM, E.EMPLY_SQ
SELECT STAFF_SQ, STAFF_NM, EMAIL, ORG_NM, DEPT_NM FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M WHERE STATUS_CD = 'WORK' AND IFNULL(EMPLY_ID, '') = '' ORDER BY STAFF_NM

SELECT E.EMPLY_SQ, E.EMPLY_ID, E.EMPLY_NM, E.EMPLY_EMAIL, E.EMPLY_PH_NUM, E.EMPLY_HOME_ADDR, E.EMPLY_SEX_TYP_CD, E.EMPLY_RRN, E.EMPLY_AUTH_TYP_CD , IFNULL(E.USE_YN, 'Y') AS USE_YN, IFNULL(E.DEL_YN, 'N') AS DEL_YN, E.PW_INIT_YN , DATE_FORMAT(E.LAST_LOGIN_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS LAST_LOGIN_DT, LEFT(E.EMPLY_REG_DT, 10) AS REG_DT , S.STAFF_SQ, S.STATUS_CD AS STAFF_STATUS, S.STAFF_NM , FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M E LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M S ON S.EMPLY_ID = E.EMPLY_ID WHERE E.EMPLY_SQ = #{sq}
SELECT STAFF_SQ, STAFF_NM, EMAIL, PHONE, STATUS_CD, EMPLY_ID FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M WHERE STAFF_SQ = #{staffSq}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID} AND EMPLY_SQ <> #{EMPLY_SQ}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_EMPLY_M (EMPLY_ID, EMPLY_PW, EMPLY_NM, EMPLY_AUTH_TYP_CD, EMPLY_PH_NUM, EMPLY_EMAIL, USE_YN, DEL_YN, PW_INIT_YN, EMPLY_REG_DT) VALUES (#{EMPLY_ID}, #{EMPLY_PW}, #{EMPLY_NM}, #{TYPE_CD}, #{EMPLY_PH_NUM,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{EMPLY_EMAIL,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y', 'N', 'Y', NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_USER_ROLE_R SET EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID} WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{OLD_ID}
UPDATE TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M SET EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID} WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{OLD_ID}
UPDATE TB_EEP_EMPLY_M SET EMPLY_PW = #{EMPLY_PW}, PW_INIT_YN = 'Y', EMPLY_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE EMPLY_SQ = #{EMPLY_SQ}
UPDATE TB_EEP_EMPLY_M SET EMPLY_AUTH_TYP_CD = #{TYPE_CD}, EMPLY_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE EMPLY_SQ = #{EMPLY_SQ}
UPDATE TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M SET EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID} WHERE STAFF_SQ = #{STAFF_SQ} AND IFNULL(EMPLY_ID, '') = ''
UPDATE TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M SET EMPLY_ID = NULL WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{emplyId}
mapper.select: SELECT EMPLY_PW FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{emplyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_EMPLY_M SET EMPLY_PW = #{EMPLY_PW}, PW_INIT_YN = 'N', EMPLY_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID}
UPDATE TB_EEP_EMPLY_M SET LAST_LOGIN_DT = NOW() WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{emplyId}
